image_analysis.title: Solution Analysis
image_analysis.info_message: Take a photo or select an image with a quadratic equation solution
image_analysis.correct_explanation: The solution is correct. The discriminant and roots were calculated properly.
image_analysis.analysis_retry: The image could not be analyzed. Please try again.
image_analysis.decode_failed: The image could not be read
image_analysis.enter_equation_first: Enter the equation coefficients first. Then the app will show the correct solution for comparison.
image_analysis.photo_quality_hint: The photo is not clear enough for a reliable analysis. Retake it with better lighting, closer to the paper, and without extra background.
image_analysis.offline_review_hint: The local offline version does not yet recognize handwritten text accurately enough. The app therefore shows a reference solution so you can compare the photo manually.
image_analysis.offline_review_issue: Automatic handwritten-solution recognition is limited in this version
image_analysis.low_resolution: The image resolution is too low
image_analysis.too_bright: The photo is too bright or overexposed
image_analysis.low_contrast: The contrast between text and background is too low
image_analysis.not_enough_text: There is almost no visible written solution in the image
image_analysis.correct_solution_placeholder: Upload a solution and enter coefficients to get a reference answer.
image_analysis.mock_substitution_error: Coefficients were substituted into the formula incorrectly
image_analysis.mock_discriminant_hint: Check the formula D = b² - 4ac and recalculate the product 4ac carefully.
image_analysis.mock_formula_error: The root formula was applied incorrectly
image_analysis.mock_roots_hint: The discriminant is correct, but the numerator or denominator in the root formula is wrong.
image_analysis.mock_equation_error: The original equation was written incorrectly
image_analysis.mock_multiple_hint: Several typical mistakes were found. Recheck the equation, discriminant, and root formulas step by step.
